reasons.plausibility: The proposal aligns with established thermal-spray science, linking higher particle velocity to better deposition efficiency and reduced oxidation through shorter in-flight time.
reasons.testability: A direct comparative experiment with baseline and modified spray conditions measuring thickness, oxidation, and adhesion provides a clear means to confirm or refute the claim.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses a common practical challenge of increasing coating thickness without compromising quality and offers a clear, implementable process parameter modification.
